overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a vote on officer elections flowed naturally from the posted election discussion item, so the July 12 notice was sufficient. No orders issued; the Commission's prompt corrective action was commended.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission voted to elect officers on July 12, but the notice listed only 'Commission Election Discussion' under Old Business.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law where the vote flowed naturally from the Commission's consideration of the posted agenda item, such that the notice was sufficient to inform the public of the discussion that occurred.
